newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES DIVE IN QUIET MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - VOLUMES DIVE IN QUIET MARKET.

text.p: Activity slowed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange in the week ended June 13, bourse officials said.
They said volumes fell to 298,041 shares valued at 17.19 million kwacha, from 4,039,281 shares worth 221.28 million kwacha the previous week. The index jumped five percent to 187.27 from 178.23.
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 105 kwacha and saw 101,158 shares valued at 10.64 million kwacha.
Rothmans remained steady at 50 kwacha, a year high, in a traded volume of 7,000 shares valued at 0.35 million kwacha.
Newly-listed Zambia Breweries closed at 210 kwacha and saw 5,000 shares traded valued at 1.03 million kwacha.
Zambia Sugar gained two kwacha to close at 29 kwacha and saw 178,180 shares traded for a value of 5.10 million kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines, Trans Zambezi Industries and Farmers House were untraded during the week.

An exchange spokesman said the average PE (profit/earnings ratio) was now 8.68. "(This is) a significant increase caused by the general upward rise in share prices and the listing of Zambian Breweries at a PE of around 12," a spokesman said.
